fusions.name: Sting Flurry
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 poison damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Tally
fusions.desc: Fires a barbed stinger that deals 14 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Hive Rhythm
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Worker's Tempo
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
